N-add06#1.zh: 此路是我开，此树是我栽，欲往此山过，留下买路财！
N-add06#1.t: I opened this road, I planted these trees; to pass this mountain, you'll pay my fees!

N-add06#2.zh: 哼！这种老掉牙的台词了也拿出来说，同为强盗我真替你们感到可耻！
N-add06#2.t: Hmph! Trotting out such tired old lines? As fellow bandits, I'm ashamed of you!

N-add06#4.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败所有敌人

N-add06#6.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N-add06#7.t: %N died. Overwhelmed by the bandits, the group left only a few more heroic ghosts in the wilds........
